kinds.title: Characters
kinds.what: character numbers (`no`), not roster slots: `rq.chara.find(rq.ids.chara.KAORU_QUINCY)` gives the slot

kinds.title: Character types
kinds.what: character type values (`タイプ`), as in `rq.chara.get(iic).type`

kinds.title: Elements
kinds.what: element numbers (`属性`), as in a skill's `element` and `rq.chara.get(iic).weak_element`

kinds.title: Items
kinds.what: item numbers, not instances: `rq.item.give(rq.ids.item.SKILL_AGAIN)` makes one

kinds.title: Item kinds
kinds.what: item kinds (`種類詳細`): the weapon or armor kind, as in an item's `subtype`

kinds.title: Map kinds
kinds.what: map kinds (`◆ＭＡＰ基礎型`): the look of a quest's area, as in `rq.dungeon.on_area`'s `ctx.kind`. The game names none; these names are ours, after the picture the game gives each kind

entries.name: Building
entries.detail: a department store, Hanny Secret Base, Zombie Room

entries.name: Field
entries.detail: Meg's Ranch, Clicquot Pasture, Hanny Village

entries.name: Ruins
entries.detail: a stone corridor: Lerolen, Wamasya, Abandoned Mine

entries.name: Burning Forest
entries.detail: Kalar Forest on fire, in The Third Army of Helman

entries.name: Malgrid X
entries.detail: Malgrid Dungeon Xth Stratum, strata up to 15

entries.name: Malgrid X Deep
entries.detail: Malgrid Dungeon Xth Stratum, strata past 15

kinds.title: Monsters
kinds.what: monster numbers, as `rq.battle.start` takes them and `rq.battle.snap()` gives them (`enemies[i].no`)

kinds.title: Music
kinds.what: music track numbers, as `rq.music.replace` and `rq.music.play` take them and `rq.music.current()` gives them

kinds.title: Party states
kinds.what: where a character is (`登録状態`), as `rq.party.state` and `rq.chara.get(iic).state` give it and `rq.party.roster` takes it. The game names none; these names are ours, after its functions `キャラ_スタメン` to `キャラ_２軍`

entries.name: Reserve
entries.detail: the first army, free to join the party

entries.name: Used
entries.detail: the first army, switched out in this quest: not placed again until the quest ends

entries.name: The Life Span of a Kunoichi
Once More to the Kalar Forest
The Girl Who Waits for Rance
Let's Play with the Emperor's Armor

kinds.title: Races
kinds.what: races (`種族`), as in `rq.chara.get(iic).race` and the damage hooks' `ctx.race`

kinds.title: States
kinds.what: status values (`状態変化`), as in `rq.chara.get(iic).status`

kinds.title: Skill targets
kinds.what: skill target codes (`対象`), as in a skill's `target`
